title: Addition and subtraction double-round through x87 64-bit significand precision and retain computed subnormals
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, + and - coerce operands left-to-right to numbers and evaluate each operation at x87 64-bit significand precision (PC64) before rounding to binary64, differing by 1 ULP from IEEE-754 binary64 single rounding on every row of dc6qki_arith rows 25-52 (e.g. 0.9882+0.000000004364549 = 0x3fef9f559d94e3b2 vs nearest ...e3b3). Unlike * and /, + and - retain computed subnormal results (0 + EXP(-745) = 2^-1074), while parsed subnormal literals flush to 0.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in dc6qki_arith (rows 25-52), jnt_operators (rows 1-4, 21), and dc-1943 computed-subnormal probes.

correct.how: Exact rational sum of both binary64 operands and decimal literals, rounded to nearest binary64
